summary: 31-year-old female climber stuck while scrambling on the Second Flatiron, unable to move up or down; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group reached her with technical gear and lowered her down; uninjured, hiked back to the trailhead.
notes: Alpine Institute roundup (2020-11-12) citing Boulder County Sheriff's Office via Out There Colorado; Sunday-afternoon item pins to 2020-11-08. BCSO case #20-4950 NOT confirmed for this incident and not attached.
